test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

No sooner he was / brought to the hospital / than he began panting heavily.
solution:
Here, the error lies in the part **"No sooner he was."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is the use of **"he was"** after** "no sooner."**
 
• **"No sooner"** is a conjunction and requires an inversion of the subject and auxiliary verb.
 
• The correct structure is **"No sooner + auxiliary verb + subject + verb" or "No sooner + subject + auxiliary verb + verb."**
 
 
• **Example: ***No sooner had she finished her speech than the lights went out.*
 
 
 
• The correct structure is *"No sooner was he brought to the hospital" or "He was no sooner brought to the hospital than he began panting heavily."*
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.
